description: Returns how many of the 510 public commercial contracts in the CUAD v1 dataset contain a clause type, as counted for the FixMyContract /data/cuad page. Without an argument, returns every clause category, most common first.

clause.description: Optional clause type or CUAD category name, e.g. "cap on liability".

name: get_clause_frequency
title: Clause frequency in public contracts (CUAD)
